locations: Chicago, Illinois, US; <span class="jobGeoLocationPin glyphicon glyphicon-map-marker icon-map-marker" aria-hidden="true">
description:
COFCO International is a global agri-business with a clear vision, strong values and a positive culture, focused on being a leader in the global grains, oilseeds and sugar supply chains. We provide the food the world needs in a responsible way. Headquartered is Geneva, Switzerland, we are ambitious, with the right structures and culture to meet the world's increasing and changing needs. With 11,000+ people in 35 countries, our global portfolio includes assets across the Americas, Europe, Africa, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We trade with over 50 nations, while providing farmers unique direct access to the growing Chinese market.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Legal Counsel to support the North America Region of COFCO International. The role will provide comprehensive legal advice and support on corporate and secretarial matters, entity governance, and commercial legal issues affecting the U.S.  and Mexico businesses. The ideal candidate will have 7+ years of post-qualification experience, with exposure to the agricultural commodities or trading industry highly desirable.

This role will act as a key legal business partner, ensuring compliance with U.S. and Mexico corporate requirements while supporting strategic initiatives across the North America region.

Key Responsibilities

• Corporate Governance & Secretarial

• Manage corporate governance matters for the U.S. and Mexico entities, including board meetings, resolutions, and statutory filings.

• Ensure compliance with all federal and state regulations related to corporate structure and governance.

• Maintain corporate records and liaise with external corporate agents as required.

• Legal Advisory & Business Partnering

• Provide legal advice on commercial contracts, corporate law, and regulatory matters relevant to the agricultural commodities industry.

• Support business teams on structuring and negotiating agreements, including supply, distribution, and joint ventures.

• Advise on cross-border transactions, working closely with global legal colleagues.

• Risk Management & Compliance

• Monitor and advise on legal risks associated with business operations in the U.S. and Mexico

• Support compliance with applicable laws, including trade, anti-bribery, sanctions, and data protection.

• Assist in implementing and maintaining internal policies and procedures to mitigate legal risk.

• Collaboration & Representation

• Work closely with global legal teams to align on international corporate governance and reporting requirements.

• Engage with external counsel for specialist advice, managing costs and ensuring high-quality output.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and business stakeholders within the U.S. and Mexico entity.

Qualifications & Experience

• J.D. degree from a recognized U.S. law school and admission to practice law in Illinois (or ability to qualify as in-house counsel).

• Minimum 7 years’ post-qualification experience, with a blend of law firm and in-house experience preferred.

• Strong expertise in corporate law, governance, and secretarial matters; additional experience in commercial contracts is a plus.

• Experience in the agricultural, commodity trading, food, or energy industries highly desirable.

• Solid understanding of U.S. corporate regulatory frameworks, with exposure to cross-border transactions.

• Excellent communication, drafting, and negotiation skills.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and provide pragmatic legal solutions in a fast-paced, international environment.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to join a leading global agri-business with strong growth ambitions.

• Exposure to a diverse and international working environment.

• A role that combines corporate governance with strategic legal advisory work.

• Competitive compensation and benefits package.

COFCO International is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice to know how COFCO collects and processes your personal data during your job application.

title: Business Analyst
description:
COFCO International is a global agri-business with a clear vision, strong values and a positive culture, focused on being a leader in the global grains, oilseeds and sugar supply chains. We provide the food the world needs in a responsible way. Headquartered is Geneva, Switzerland, we are ambitious, with the right structures and culture to meet the world's increasing and changing needs. With 11,000+ people in 35 countries, our global portfolio includes assets across the Americas, Europe, Africa, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We trade with over 50 nations, while providing farmers unique direct access to the growing Chinese market.

Main Focus:

• To act as the primary bridge between front-office stakeholders and application/technical developers, providing CTRM application functional support, troubleshooting CTRM incidents and gathering/analysis of business requirements.  As a CTRM analyst, provide and maintain process and system documentation, clarify business specifications, translating business requirements into functional specifications.

Key Responsabilities and Accountabilities:

• Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with business stakeholders and other project resources to obtain and document business requirements, both functional and non-functional, through interviews, workshops, and data analysis. Translate these requirements into clear and concise documentation.

• Business Process Analysis: Analyze existing business processes and workflows to identify areas for optimization, streamlining, and automation. Propose innovative solutions to enhance efficiency and productivity.

• Applications Support:  Provide first and second level support for the Softs US CTRM users, resolving applications processing issues and/or escalating the problems to Level 3 or vendor resources in case he/she is unable to resolve the issue.

• Feasibility Studies: Assess the feasibility of proposed processes/workflows and initiatives by conducting cost-benefit analysis, risk assessments, and impact analysis. Provide valuable insights to support decision-making and project prioritization.

• Data Analysis: Analyze data from various sources to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for business improvement. Utilize data-driven insights to make informed recommendations.

• Solution Design: Work with the development team to design and create functional specifications, use cases, and user stories that effectively communicate business requirements to technical teams.

• Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, project managers, and technical teams to foster collaboration and ensure a shared understanding of project goals and requirements.

• Change Management: Support the implementation of new processes and systems by facilitating change management activities, including training sessions, user acceptance testing (UAT), and user adoption initiatives.

• Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including business requirements, process flows, use cases, and other relevant materials.

• Quality ssurance: Assist in testing efforts to ensure that the final solutions meet the defined business requirements and quality standards.

• Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on industry best practices, emerging technologies, and business trends to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation.

Project Involvement:

• Actively participates in team meetings, contributes ideas, and supports team plans/decisions for successful project/process implementation.

• Ability to execute assigned tasks

• Communicates progress/status of assigned projects/tasks, anticipates risks and able to recommend solutions to address issues

• Works with available resources to deliver assigned tasks on agreed schedule.

Direction Received:

• General supervision will be given.

• Able to take own initiative to move forward the assigned tasks/projects

Administration and Operations:

• Comply with the established set of work standards

• Incident Management (Logging, Tracking, Communications and Reporting)

• Maintains updated systems/applications documentation

• Coordinates schedules and related tasks with other team members or other IT groups

Key Qualifications/Experiences:

• 3+ years of experience in business process analysis and software quality assurance processes.  This includes designing, defining or streamlining work processes, documenting business processes, testing and supporting CTRM applications

• Experience in Commodity Trading and Risk Management (CTRM) systems OR Financial Accounting

• Experience in trading environment or financial accounting
